title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode4 The Moon We Saw Back Then

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Moon We Saw Back Then
meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, how awesome were we just now?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought the same thing...!
That may've been the best we've ever sounded...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. That definitely was our best yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Some things are still bugging me a little, but we should be able to fix them before our show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yay!
Shiho praised us, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great.
Especially considering how hard you girls have been working.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're writing your own song too, right?
How's that been going?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At this point, we're just hammering out the details. It'll be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? I can't wait to hear it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And Ichika's writing the lyrics, yes?
Any progress on that front?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I'm not really happy with what I have right now, so I'm going to need a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. But you don't need to feel rushed, okay? I'm sure you'll find the answer if you keep at it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, what she said!
You might get a light bulb just completely out of the blue one day. You just really never know♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you really count on that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thanks, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Practices, when we're all together like this, is going well, and our original song's coming along nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're really gonna get to do a show as a band...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, once more from the top. We need to make what we just did second nature.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right. I'll count us in.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew! Great work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that went so well.
Especially our last one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, it felt so solid.
It's hard for me to put it into words, but it's like we're becoming one with the music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We've really come a long way.
However, some parts still need work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So let's keep this up and make our show a good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But make sure not to push yourselves too hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true too.
It's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Taking breaks, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me, it's almost the 15th. Why don't we all have a moon viewing party?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds wonderful! The moon's been so beautiful lately too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I forget what we're supposed to do during moon viewings, other than eating dango and putting them on display...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not sure either. Usually, we bring food or have a picnic together, like with the cherry blossoms, but what do we do for moon viewings...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I say anything goes☆
I'm sure it'll be totally fine if you just bring or make whatever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's just bring what we like and have a little feast!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds lovely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was wondering if you'd like to do a moon viewing together since it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We did them as a family when we were little, but we haven't done one in quite some time, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I was hoping to do one with you like old times... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then let's have a moon viewing party after practice on the 15th. How does that sound, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, sorry...
That just reminded me of something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Reminded you of what?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's nothing, really...
My sister actually just asked me about having a moon viewing party the other day is all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, she did?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I told her that we'd be busy with practice too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we're not little kids anymore, so I didn't really see much point in getting together as a family again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho, I think you should do a moon viewing party with Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's clear that you mean the world to her, so it'd probably be a good idea to give back for once.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She loves you so much, but it's like we're hogging you all to ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't have to put it like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree with Saki too.
I'm sure she'll be ecstatic to hear this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I know! What if we invited Shizuku and have a moon viewing party together?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then how about we all just have moon viewing parties with our own families instead?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure. I'm sure the Hinomoris would like that very much as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm for that as well.
Let's try to end practice early that day and spend some quality time with our families.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I think I'll have a moon viewing party with Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds nice. I'd like to make my own dango if I have time.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye, Shiho!
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, bye.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Moon viewings, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I sort of remember doing them with Shizuku when we were little...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The furthest back I can think of when we did one is maybe when I was still in kindergarten...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That time...)
Gym

rows.Speaker: Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, is everybody here?
We'll be having our moon viewing party today, so be sure to make some dango and enjoy pretending to be rabbits!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (I wasn't really sure what we'd be doing for this, but we get to make dango and be rabbits...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (This is gonna be so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (But how are we supposed to make dango? Is it the same as when you make them out of mud?)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, wanna make some...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to make some dango.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Friend
rows.Line: Me neither! Let's make some together, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (She's gonna make some with her other friends.)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (Then, I guess I'll...)
